title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - Software
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/Software. A computer program that can be linked with a wearable, especially for acquiring information (e.g. a companion smartphone app). Subclass of saref:FeatureOfInterest per the SAREF4WEAR ontology (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.2). The ontology declares no own data/object property for this class beyond the classification itself.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Software'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
